description: Declaring attackers (prompt 18): green creatures against green planeswalkers. The player declares attackers three ways in turn (guided): tapping them one by one - first for a planeswalker Forge offers as defender (tapped to make it the defender), then for the opponent again (tapped) -, Forge's Alpha Strike, and Alpha Strike taken back with Call Back. Forge says why a creature cannot attack: summoning sickness (cast this turn), tapped (Llanowar Elves tapped for mana), an effect (Wall of Wood's defender). In German, like the app: its moments are the attack scenes of the game table's tests.
